ننتهي (form VIII)
# نَنْتَهِي (nantahī) /nan.ta.hiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَى (intahā)
# نَنْتَهِيَ (nantahiya) /nan.ta.hi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَهَى (intahā)
